title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program 2026-27 Late Pickup Fee Schedule: Per-Minute Rate by Grade
content:
Under the board-approved 2026-27 late pickup fee schedule of the Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program, the per-minute rate follows the student's grade. The grade read is the one on the student's district enrollment record in Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions for the enrollment's school year, in status enrolled.

| Grade on that district enrollment record | Per-minute rate of the schedule |
|---|---|
| PK3 or PK4 | 1.50 per minute |
| KG | 1.25 per minute |
| 01, 02, 03, 04 or 05 | the program's late pickup fee per minute, 1.00 per minute |
| the student holds no such record (no district enrollment record for that school year in status enrolled) | the program's late pickup fee per minute, 1.00 per minute |

## Reading the record

- The record read is the district enrollment record for the same school year as the Creek Kids Club enrollment. A record of another school year does not decide the rate.
- Only a record in status enrolled counts. When the student's record for that school year shows another status, such as withdrawn, the student holds no such record and the rate is 1.00 per minute.
- The grade is taken from the district enrollment record, not from the Creek Kids Club plan or from what the family states. A kindergarten student on an after-school plan is rated by grade KG on the district record.

## Examples (hypothetical students)

| Student | District enrollment record for the school year | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| a four-year-old on the Pre-K Wraparound plan | enrolled, grade PK4 | 1.50 |
| a kindergartner on an after-school plan | enrolled, grade KG | 1.25 |
| a third grader | enrolled, grade 03 | 1.00 |
| a student who has left the district | withdrawn | 1.00 |
